recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern composition featuring a heavily textured, impasto-style painted background in muted pinks and creams. The design incorporates a 'peeling wall' effect that reveals a red brick texture underneath, overlaid with stylized, hand-drawn sketches of jazz instruments on small rectangular cards.
coreVisualRelationships: Large blue condensed typography centered against a light textured field
Red brick texture peeking through rough-edged gaps in the painted surface
Small illustrative cards clustered at the bottom center representing musical themes
Secondary red slab-serif text providing a color contrast to the primary blue title
coreInvariants: Visible palette knife strokes in the background
Rough, irregular edges on the brick reveal sections
High-contrast primary color palette (Red, Blue, Yellow) against a neutral base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title dominates the upper-middle third; the brick reveal and instrument cards anchor the lower-right and bottom-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright blue condensed lettering in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large blue title, move down to the red brick reveal, and settle on the cluster of instrument illustrations at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space provided by the textured cream/pink paint, allowing the typography to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Brick red and golden yellow (secondary text and illustrations)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for graphic elements against low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin, sharp slab serifs
Visible distressed or 'stamped' texture within the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' has deep, sharp valleys reaching the baseline
The 'C' and 'G' have very small apertures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pairing a large condensed slab serif with a smaller, wider slab serif in a contrasting color (red).

candidateDirections.reason: Similar sharp slab serifs and condensed structure
Captures the extreme condensed nature and mid-century feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an abstract oil painting background with heavy impasto texture in shades of cream and muted pink. Include a jagged, irregular cutout in the lower right that reveals a realistic red brick wall texture. At the bottom center, add a cluster of small, colorful rectangular cards featuring simple line-art sketches of musical instruments like trumpets, pianos, and basses.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, extra-condensed slab serif text in cyan blue. Above it, add a smaller line of red slab serif text. Ensure the blue text has a subtle vertical woodblock texture.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visibly thick and painterly?
Does the brick reveal look like a hole in a wall?
Is the main title font extra-condensed with sharp slab serifs?

adjustableVariables: Size of the brick reveal area
Color of the primary display text
Number of instrument cards at the bottom
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue text is the primary focal point.
Verify the brick texture looks integrated into the 'wall'.
Check that the instrument sketches maintain a hand-drawn, sketchy quality.
Confirm the color palette remains within the mid-century primary-on-neutral scheme.
recipe.reuseFormula: Impasto background + Brick reveal + Condensed Slab Serif + Sketchy Icons = Mid-Century Jazz Aesthetic
